pages.text: The $(l)Tiny Tank$() is a heavy unit capable of wiping out entire hordes with one or two well-placed shots.

pages.title: Combat Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 40$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 20$(li)$(4)Range:$() Medium$(li)$(4)Immune to:$() Knockback, Fire, Poison$(br2)Its heavy weight prevents it from being pushed back.

pages.text: Fires $(b)Missiles$() at $(6)Slow Speed$() with the power of TNT.$(br2)$(a)Safety:$() Explosions $(b)do not$() destroy blocks or damage allies.
